experiment: AF8-v3 final: fixes + re-pilot + 40-dataset exploratory run
study_type: EXPLORATORY. The 40 datasets are the AF6 datasets, already used by AF6-AF8 analyses; results are not independent confirmatory evidence. Written after the AF8-v3 pilot numerics (no accuracy of any AF8 variant has been computed).
lineage: lineage E + PR #129 generic model (prototype, not a formal method, not manuscript evidence); AF6 auto_first anchors
research_question: Does integrating the loading f_j (prior + nested Laplace E2) improve the BALANCE of the two misselection directions between Poisson and CMP2 relative to Q and to the AF6 Laplace (f optimised) score? Higher overall accuracy alone is not counted as success; Poisson->CMP2 and CMP2->Poisson errors are both evaluated.

changes_vs_v3.outer_certificate: CERT_OK only with T(f) finite and re-validated each round, finite FD gradient/Hessian, Cholesky-PD -d2T/df2, finite lambda_f^2/2 <= 1e-6, and a FINITE extra-step gain <= 1e-6 at the full Newton step or (if T is undefined there) at 1/2 or 1/4 of it; otherwise EXTRA_STEP_INVALID / EXTRA_STEP_NONFINITE / FD_NONFINITE / DECREMENT_FAIL / POINT_INVALID (failures). Every start's certificate is logged (D_start_log). A start is valid only if CERT_OK with all certificate fields finite.
changes_vs_v3.E_status: E with a non-finite value -> E_NONFINITE (failure)
changes_vs_v3.stop_rules: v3 rules unchanged; added before the re-pilot: S4v2 (v2-definition S4 <= 0.05, audit W1; stricter), S0 completeness (all expected cells present). No threshold relaxed.
changes_vs_v3.analysis: no NaN-skipping aggregation: every statistic is computed by functions that fail on NaN unless the NaN is an explicit state; completeness of the expected cell grid is checked; analysis runinfo with git head, protocol hash, environment and sha256 of every input file
changes_vs_v3.unchanged: model, theta_{-j}, data, priors, starts, inner/joint certificates, FD steps, IS proposal/draws/seeds/rescue, outer_checks, E2 as main score

data: AF6 saved datasets rep01-rep40 (regenerated from the AF6 seeds; X, Y, train-mask hashes asserted against AF6 fit_manifest; anchor state files checked by sha256); n=75, K=3, columns Gaussian x3, Poisson x3, CMP2 x3; dense-Y and sparse-Y; same Auto (auto_first) anchor. No MCEM fit, no new data.

units.cell: dataset x regime x count column x candidate x prior (40 x 2 x 6 x 2 x 9 = 8640)
units.column: dataset x regime x count column (480); selection unit
units.statistical_unit: dataset (40). Columns and regimes are not independent; dense and sparse are reported separately and pooled with dataset-cluster resampling

methods.B_L6: AF6 Laplace delta (f maximises the Z-Laplace objective, no prior), comparator; AF6 status FAILED -> failed (no Q fallback)
methods.C_JM: AF6 delta_jointmap_variant (joint MAP then Laplace), comparator
methods.D_MAP: max_f T(f) = S(f) + log p(f) (prior, f optimised, not integrated), comparator
methods.E2: MAIN: nested Laplace, T(f_D) + K/2 log 2pi - 1/2 log|FD Hessian of -T|
methods.E: joint Laplace over (vec Z, f_j), comparator / approximation diagnostic
methods.IS: f integrated by importance sampling given the Z-Laplace S(f) (main prior only): numerical check of the outer Gaussian approximation of E2, NOT the exact marginal

fixed_choices: main method E2 and main prior B_sg2_0.667 are fixed here and not changed after seeing accuracy; E vs E2 is not chosen by performance

selection.Delta: M(CMP2) - M(Poisson) for every method; CMP2 if Delta > 0
selection.u: E2: v2.selection_state (u = max(0.01, 2 x FD-Hessian-step sensitivity)); other methods: 0.01
selection.validity: E2: cell status OK (certified, multistart AGREE or dominant); E: E_status OK; D: E2_status OK (same optimisation); IS: IS_status OK; B: AF6 status in FINITE_DELTA with finite delta; C: finite delta_jointmap_variant; A: q_status SELECTED
selection.no_fallback: a failed / undecided / missing column is NEVER replaced by Q; a Q-fallback hybrid is reported only as a separately named exploratory secondary method (E2|Q)

metrics.denominators: acc_all = correct decided / all columns of that truth (failed, undecided and missing count as not correct); acc_evaluable = correct / decided columns; rates of decided, undecided, failed, missing reported separately
secondary: AUC of Delta (finite scores; n reported)
per-dataset #correct difference E2-Q, E2-B, E2-D, E2-E, D-B
right->wrong and wrong->right transitions by truth
sign-based accuracy (undecided resolved by sign) as sensitivity
prior sensitivity (D, E2, E for every prior)
metrics.bootstrap: dataset-cluster bootstrap (resample the 40 datasets with both regimes and all columns), 10000 resamples, seed 20261118 (AF8 BOOT_SEED), percentile 95% CI
metrics.multiplicity: one primary comparison family (E2 vs Q and E2 vs B on the per-truth accuracies and balanced accuracy, main prior); CIs are unadjusted; all other comparisons and the prior sensitivity are exploratory

ambiguous_columns_label_free: main prior, E2 valid: |Delta_E2| <= 1, or sign(Delta_E) != sign(Delta_E2), or sign(Delta_IS) != sign(Delta_E2), or E2 state NUMERIC_UNDECIDED. Diagnostics reported for them (IS +- 2 se, decomposition of Delta_E - Delta_E2, FD-step sensitivity); never used to change method, prior or thresholds
stop_rule_units: S1, S2, S2b over all cells of the stage; S3/S3b over main-prior pairs with both IS valid; S4, S4v2, S4r, S4b, S5, S8, S9 over main-prior cells; S6 over main-prior pairs; S7 (FD derivative check) in the re-pilot only (column 3, main prior, every pilot case)

gates.re_pilot: rep01-rep03, 648 cells, numerical only (no accuracy, no AUC). ANY stop rule -> no 40-dataset run
gates.full: rep01-rep40, 8640 cells. The same stop rules are evaluated on the full run BEFORE any accuracy is computed; if any fires the analysis refuses to compute accuracy and the run is reported as stopped
gates.publication: after a passing re-pilot: push the v3 branch and open a Draft PR on the AF8-v2 branch

not_claimed: Bayesian evidence of the whole model (theta_{-j} fixed)
E2 ~ IS implies closeness to the exact (Z, f) marginal
